text.text_excerpt: Bonafried is an awesome food truck for fried chicken sandwiches! I had it twice so far and the sandwiches are pretty good! I had the T.N. Hot, The Special, and the Southern Fried Chicken Sandwiches so far. I follow Bonafried on Facebook, so I can find out where the truck will be. The owners don't really post a weekly schedule like some trucks do, but rather post where they'd be when they park. They seem to not serve on Sundays and Mondays. Other days are more predictable, but never a guarantee. After seeing the them post a picture of the T.N. Hot Fried Chicken Sandwich on their Facebook, I HAD to get my hands on it! When the time came around to it, I was super excited to try it! The sandw...

Food truck shmood truck, Bonafried sells honestly some of the best fried chicken sliders and fries I can remember having. So hot, so crunchy, so juicy, much wow. The spicy Tennessee chicken sliders with pickles were unfreaking believable. Great food truck to grab a bite while watching the Red Sox play at 45 Tchop. Can't go wrong giving this a try.... unless you're counting calories!

My favorite food truck in New Orleans. Follow them on Facebook because they will often put up a weekly schedule, and if not they post where they are each day. Often outside Tulane Hospital on Fridays just as a heads up Incredible, filling fried chicken sandwiches and fries for $11.00. Of the sandwiches I've tried, they have all been phenomenal. The chicken is always crispy, the bun always warm and soft. Portions are hefty. The Special - A little hot a little sweet and my favorite T.N. Hot - also incredible if you like spicy food.
